title: Wayfare Rentals Damage Charge Schedule and In-Vehicle Conduct Terms
content:
Damage to a Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals) vehicle is charged to the renter from the schedule below, never above the class's damage deductible for one incident.

## Part 1. Charge by damage category, before the deductible cap

The same category charges apply to every vehicle class.

| Damage category | Charge |
|---|---|
| Minor scrape | $150.00 |
| Dent | $350.00 |
| Glass | $300.00 |
| Interior | $200.00 |
| Major collision | Charged at the class's damage deductible |

## Part 2. Damage deductible by class

The damage deductible is the most a renter pays for damage from one incident.

| Vehicle class | Damage deductible |
|---|---|
| Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan | $750.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan | $750.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Electric Sedan | $1000.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV | $1000.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Minivan | $1000.00 |
| Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan | $1500.00 |

## Part 3. Wear, smoking, pets and disputes

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Normal wear (tire wear, small stone chips under the size of a coin, interior wear) | Never charged, every class |
| Smoking or vaping in the vehicle | Not allowed, every class; smoke damage is charged as interior damage |
| Non-service pets riding in the vehicle off-trip | Allowed in the Economy Sedan, Hybrid Sedan, Electric Sedan, Midsize SUV and Minivan; not allowed in the Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan |
| Period to dispute a damage charge | 14 calendar days after the damage charge, every class |

## Reading the schedule: hypothetical incidents

- A dent found on a Wayfare Rentals Hybrid Sedan is charged $350.00, which is below that class's $750.00 deductible.
- A major collision on a Wayfare Rentals Premium Sedan is charged at that class's deductible, $1500.00; on a Wayfare Rentals Midsize SUV it would be $1000.00.
- Smoke damage found in a Wayfare Rentals Economy Sedan is charged as interior damage, $200.00.
- Tire wear alone on any class is normal wear and carries no charge.
